title: selago gracilis
intro: Selago gracilis, commonly known as Blue King, is a flowering plant native to South Africa. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Selago gracilis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to have a protective effect on the body. The bioactive constituents of Selago gracilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
